name: 48097 · Yale, MI
findings: ZIP 48097 (Yale) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (77%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48097 (Yale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48097 (Yale) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
